fullText.simplified:
第13章、张一南的信（上）

    李河打开第一个信封。这是一封手写信，字很漂亮，内容如下：

高静，
    我终于找到你了！太高兴了，我要感谢这一天，二月二十七日，我是在这一天找到你的。
    我是张一南，你应该还记得我吧？从十六岁那年你离开后，我就一直在找你。你这个坏女人，怎么可以一句话都不说，就一个人跑掉？你是我的女人，我没有同意，你怎么能离开？你知道我有多难过吗？
    现在好了，我终于找到你了！你还是和以前一样漂亮，但是我变了。你以为我还喜欢你吗？我是因为喜欢你，所以给你写信吗？你错了！在找你的这些年里，我早就变了。知道吗，以前我有多喜欢你，现在我就有多恨你！这些年我过得很辛苦，做什么都不顺利，你却过得很开心，这真是太让人生气了。我现在告诉你，从收到这封信的时候起，你的好生活就结束了！
    我要让你害怕，我太知道怎样让一个人害怕了。忘记说了，我还有另一个名字——春草。没错，那个有名的侦探小说家春草就是我。四年前我因为太恨你，开始写小说。在我的小说里，每一个被坏人杀死的女人都是你。我知道你喜欢读小说，我的那些书，你都读过了吧？怎么样，想到被杀的人是自己，你害怕吗？
    想到你害怕的样子，我就很高兴。你想报警吗？没关系，你去报吧。既然我给你写信了，那就是我已经准备好了。没有人知道春草在哪儿，也没有人找得到张一南。春草没有家，张一南也没有家，我是没有家的人。
    高静，我会每天都看着你。一个星期后，我会给你写第二封信。
    今晚，你应该睡不着觉吧？
张一南
4月3日

    李河吃惊极了，他不敢相信。什么？春草叫张一南？春草是高静以前的男朋友？这真是那个大作家春草写的信？
fullText.traditional:
第13章、張一南的信（上）

    李河打開第一個信封。這是一封手寫信，字很漂亮，內容如下：

高靜，
    我終於找到你了！太高興了，我要感謝這一天，二月二十七日，我是在這一天找到你的。
    我是張一南，你應該還記得我吧？從十六歲那年你離開後，我就一直在找你。你這個壞女人，怎麼可以一句話都不說，就一個人跑掉？你是我的女人，我沒有同意，你怎麼能離開？你知道我有多難過嗎？
    現在好了，我終於找到你了！你還是和以前一樣漂亮，但是我變了。你以為我還喜歡你嗎？我是因為喜歡你，所以給你寫信嗎？你錯了！在找你的這些年裡，我早就變了。知道嗎，以前我有多喜歡你，現在我就有多恨你！這些年我過得很辛苦，做什麼都不順利，你卻過得很開心，這真是太讓人生氣了。我現在告訴你，從收到這封信的時候起，你的好生活就結束了！
    我要讓你害怕，我太知道怎樣讓一個人害怕了。忘記說了，我還有另一個名字——春草。沒錯，那個有名的偵探小說家春草就是我。四年前我因為太恨你，開始寫小說。在我的小說裡，每一個被壞人殺死的女人都是你。我知道你喜歡讀小說，我的那些書，你都讀過了吧？怎麼樣，想到被殺的人是自己，你害怕嗎？
    想到你害怕的樣子，我就很高興。你想報警嗎？沒關係，你去報吧。既然我給你寫信了，那就是我已經準備好了。沒有人知道春草在哪兒，也沒有人找得到張一南。春草沒有家，張一南也沒有家，我是沒有家的人。
    高靜，我會每天都看著你。一個星期後，我會給你寫第二封信。
    今晚，你應該睡不著覺吧？
張一南
4月3日

    李河吃驚極了，他不敢相信。什麼？春草叫張一南？春草是高靜以前的男朋友？這真是那個大作家春草寫的信？

sentences.traditional: 我終於找到你了！太高興了，我要感謝這一天，二月二十七日，我是在這一天找到你的。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhōng yú zhǎo dào nǐ le tài gāo xìng le wǒ yào gǎn xiè zhè yì tiān èr yuè èr shí qī rì wǒ shì zài zhè yì tiān zhǎo dào nǐ de
sentences.english: I have finally found you! I’m so happy! I want to give thanks to this day, February 27, the day that I found you.

sentences.simplified: 我是张一南，你应该还记得我吧？从十六岁那年你离开后，我就一直在找你。
sentences.traditional: 我是張一南，你應該還記得我吧？從十六歲那年你離開後，我就一直在找你。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shì zhāng yī nán nǐ yīng gāi hái jì de wǒ ba cóng shí liù suì nà nián nǐ lí kāi hòu wǒ jiù yì zhí zài zhǎo nǐ
sentences.english: I’m Zhang Yinan. You must still remember me. I have been looking for you since you left when we were 16.

sentences.simplified: 你这个坏女人，怎么可以一句话都不说，就一个人跑掉？
sentences.traditional: 你這個壞女人，怎麼可以一句話都不說，就一個人跑掉？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ zhè ge huài nǚ rén zěn me kě yǐ yí jù huà dōu bù shuō jiù yí ge rén pǎo diào
sentences.english: You bad woman, how could you run away without saying a word?

sentences.simplified: 你是我的女人，我没有同意，你怎么能离开？你知道我有多难过吗？
sentences.traditional: 你是我的女人，我沒有同意，你怎麼能離開？你知道我有多難過嗎？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ shì wǒ de nǚ rén wǒ méi yǒu tóng yì nǐ zěn me néng lí kāi nǐ zhī dào wǒ yǒu duō nán guò ma
sentences.english: You are my woman, and I did not agree to it. How could you leave? Do you know how sad I was?

sentences.simplified: 现在好了，我终于找到你了！你还是和以前一样漂亮，但是我变了。
sentences.traditional: 現在好了，我終於找到你了！你還是和以前一樣漂亮，但是我變了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài hǎo le wǒ zhōng yú zhǎo dào nǐ le nǐ hái shi hé yǐ qián yí yàng piào liang dàn shì wǒ biàn le
sentences.english: It’s okay now that I’ve finally found you! You are still as beautiful as before, but I have changed.

sentences.simplified: 你以为我还喜欢你吗？我是因为喜欢你，所以给你写信吗？
sentences.traditional: 你以為我還喜歡你嗎？我是因為喜歡你，所以給你寫信嗎？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yǐ wéi wǒ hái xǐ huan nǐ ma wǒ shì yīn wèi xǐ huan nǐ suǒ yǐ gěi nǐ xiě xìn ma
sentences.english: Are you under the impression that I still like you? That I’m writing you because I like you? You’re wrong!

sentences.simplified: 你错了！在找你的这些年里，我早就变了。
sentences.traditional: 你錯了！在找你的這些年裡，我早就變了。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ cuò le zài zhǎo nǐ de zhè xiē nián lǐ wǒ zǎo jiù biàn le
sentences.english: I have changed during these years that I have been looking for you.

sentences.simplified: 知道吗，以前我有多喜欢你，现在我就有多恨你！
sentences.traditional: 知道嗎，以前我有多喜歡你，現在我就有多恨你！
sentences.pinyin: zhī dào ma yǐ qián wǒ yǒu duō xǐ huan nǐ xiàn zài wǒ jiù yǒu duō hèn nǐ
sentences.english: You know, I hate you as much now as I liked you before.

sentences.simplified: 这些年我过得很辛苦，做什么都不顺利，你却过得很开心，这真是太让人生气了。
sentences.traditional: 這些年我過得很辛苦，做什麼都不順利，你卻過得很開心，這真是太讓人生氣了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē nián wǒ guò dé hěn xīn kǔ zuò shén me dōu bú shùn lì nǐ què guò dé hěn kāi xīn zhè zhēn shi tài ràng rén shēng qì le
sentences.english: I have had a hard time all these years. Nothing I did went smoothly. But you lived very happily. This really made me angry.

sentences.simplified: 我现在告诉你，从收到这封信的时候起，你的好生活就结束了！
sentences.traditional: 我現在告訴你，從收到這封信的時候起，你的好生活就結束了！
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiàn zài gào su nǐ cóng shōu dào zhè fēng xìn de shí hou qǐ nǐ de hǎo shēng huó jiù jié shù le
sentences.english: Now I am telling you that after you receive this letter, your good life is over!

sentences.simplified: 我要让你害怕，我太知道怎样让一个人害怕了。
sentences.traditional: 我要讓你害怕，我太知道怎樣讓一個人害怕了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yào ràng nǐ hài pà wǒ tài zhī dào zěn yàng ràng yí ge rén hài pà le
sentences.english: I want to scare you, and I know how to make people scared.

sentences.simplified: 忘记说了，我还有另一个名字——春草。没错，那个有名的侦探小说家春草就是我。
sentences.traditional: 忘記說了，我還有另一個名字——春草。沒錯，那個有名的偵探小說家春草就是我。
sentences.pinyin: wàng jì shuō le wǒ hái yǒu lìng yí ge míng zi chūn cǎo méi cuò nà ge yǒu míng de zhēn tàn xiǎo shuō jiā chūn cǎo jiù shì wǒ
sentences.english: I forgot to mention, I have another name—Chun Cao. That’s right, that famous detective novelist Chun Cao is me.

sentences.simplified: 四年前我因为太恨你，开始写小说。
sentences.traditional: 四年前我因為太恨你，開始寫小說。
sentences.pinyin: sì nián qián wǒ yīn wèi tài hèn nǐ kāi shǐ xiě xiǎo shuō
sentences.english: I started writing novels four years ago because I hated you too much.

sentences.simplified: 在我的小说里，每一个被坏人杀死的女人都是你。
sentences.traditional: 在我的小說裡，每一個被壞人殺死的女人都是你。
sentences.pinyin: zài wǒ de xiǎo shuō lǐ měi yí ge bèi huài rén shā sǐ de nǚ rén dōu shì nǐ
sentences.english: In my novels, every woman killed by a bad guy is you.

sentences.simplified: 我知道你喜欢读小说，我的那些书，你都读过了吧？
sentences.traditional: 我知道你喜歡讀小說，我的那些書，你都讀過了吧？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào nǐ xǐ huan dú xiǎo shuō wǒ de nà xiē shū nǐ dōu dú guò le ba
sentences.english: I know you like to read novels. Haven’t you read all of my books?

sentences.simplified: 怎么样，想到被杀的人是自己，你害怕吗？
sentences.traditional: 怎麼樣，想到被殺的人是自己，你害怕嗎？
sentences.pinyin: zěn me yàng xiǎng dào bèi shā de rén shì zì jǐ nǐ hài pà ma
sentences.english: How were they? Were you scared thinking that the person who was killed was you?

sentences.simplified: 想到你害怕的样子，我就很高兴。你想报警吗？
sentences.traditional: 想到你害怕的樣子，我就很高興。你想報警嗎？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng dào nǐ hài pà de yàng zi wǒ jiù hěn gāo xìng nǐ xiǎng bào jǐng ma
sentences.english: Thinking about how scared you are makes me happy. Do you want to report it to the police?

sentences.simplified: 没关系，你去报吧。既然我给你写信了，那就是我已经准备好了。
sentences.traditional: 沒關係，你去報吧。既然我給你寫信了，那就是我已經準備好了。
sentences.pinyin: méi guān xi nǐ qù bào ba jì rán wǒ gěi nǐ xiě xìn le nà jiù shì wǒ yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo le
sentences.english: It doesn’t matter; you can report it. Now that I am writing to you, I’m already done preparing everything.

sentences.simplified: 没有人知道春草在哪儿，也没有人找得到张一南。
sentences.traditional: 沒有人知道春草在哪兒，也沒有人找得到張一南。
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu rén zhī dào chūn cǎo zài nǎ'r yě méi yǒu rén zhǎo dé dào zhāng yī nán
sentences.english: No one knows where Chun Cao is, and no one can find Zhang Yinan.

sentences.simplified: 春草没有家，张一南也没有家，我是没有家的人。
sentences.traditional: 春草沒有家，張一南也沒有家，我是沒有家的人。
sentences.pinyin: chūn cǎo méi yǒu jiā zhāng yī nán yě méi yǒu jiā wǒ shì méi yǒu jiā de rén
sentences.english: Chun Cao has no home, and Zhang Yinan has no home. I am a person without a home.

sentences.simplified: 高静，我会每天都看着你。一个星期后，我会给你写第二封信。
sentences.traditional: 高靜，我會每天都看著你。一個星期後，我會給你寫第二封信。
sentences.pinyin: gāo jìng wǒ huì měi tiān dōu kàn zhe nǐ yí ge xīng qī hòu wǒ huì gěi nǐ xiě dì èr fēng xìn
sentences.english: Gao Jing, I will watch you every day. In one week, I will write a second letter to you.

sentences.simplified: 今晚，你应该睡不着觉吧？
sentences.traditional: 今晚，你應該睡不著覺吧？
sentences.pinyin: jīn wǎn nǐ yīng gāi shuì bù zháo jiào ba
sentences.english: You won’t be able to sleep tonight, will you?

sentences.simplified: 张一南
sentences.traditional: 張一南
sentences.pinyin: zhāng yī nán
sentences.english: Zhang Yinan

sentences.simplified: 4月3日
sentences.traditional: 4月3日
sentences.pinyin: 1 yuè 1 rì

sentences.pinyin: lǐ hé chī jīng jí le tā bù gǎn xiāng xìn shén me chūn cǎo jiào zhāng yī nán
sentences.english: Li He was very taken aback. He couldn’t believe it. What? Chun Cao’s name was Zhang Yinan?

sentences.simplified: 春草是高静以前的男朋友？这真是那个大作家春草写的信？
sentences.traditional: 春草是高靜以前的男朋友？這真是那個大作家春草寫的信？
sentences.pinyin: chūn cǎo shì gāo jìng yǐ qián de nán péng you zhè zhēn shi nà ge dà zuò jiā chūn cǎo xiě de xìn
sentences.english: Chun Cao was Gao Jing’s ex-boyfriend? Was this letter really written by that great author Chun Cao?

sentence_translations: Chapter 13: Zhang Yinan’s Letters (1)
Li He opened the first envelope. It was a handwritten letter with beautiful characters, and the content was as follows:
Gao Jing,
I have finally found you! I’m so happy! I want to give thanks to this day, February 27, the day that I found you.
I’m Zhang Yinan. You must still remember me. I have been looking for you since you left when we were 16.
You bad woman, how could you run away without saying a word?
You are my woman, and I did not agree to it. How could you leave? Do you know how sad I was?
It’s okay now that I’ve finally found you! You are still as beautiful as before, but I have changed.
Are you under the impression that I still like you? That I’m writing you because I like you? You’re wrong!
I have changed during these years that I have been looking for you.
You know, I hate you as much now as I liked you before.
I have had a hard time all these years. Nothing I did went smoothly. But you lived very happily. This really made me angry.
Now I am telling you that after you receive this letter, your good life is over!
I want to scare you, and I know how to make people scared.
I forgot to mention, I have another name—Chun Cao. That’s right, that famous detective novelist Chun Cao is me.
I started writing novels four years ago because I hated you too much.
In my novels, every woman killed by a bad guy is you.
I know you like to read novels. Haven’t you read all of my books?
How were they? Were you scared thinking that the person who was killed was you?
Thinking about how scared you are makes me happy. Do you want to report it to the police?
It doesn’t matter; you can report it. Now that I am writing to you, I’m already done preparing everything.
No one knows where Chun Cao is, and no one can find Zhang Yinan.
Chun Cao has no home, and Zhang Yinan has no home. I am a person without a home.
Gao Jing, I will watch you every day. In one week, I will write a second letter to you.
You won’t be able to sleep tonight, will you?
Zhang Yinan
April 3
Li He was very taken aback. He couldn’t believe it. What? Chun Cao’s name was Zhang Yinan?
Chun Cao was Gao Jing’s ex-boyfriend? Was this letter really written by that great author Chun Cao?
